reviews.text:
The packaging alone almost convinced me to keep this on display forever. Once I finally used it, I was relieved to discover that the formula is every bit as beautiful as the compact itself.

Shimmer Souffle gives the cheeks a soft flush with a subtle luminous effect that makes the skin look healthy and fresh. The powder feels silky and blends effortlessly without becoming patchy. It's one of those blushes that makes you look naturally pretty rather than obviously made up.
reviews.zh:
單係個包裝已經差啲令我想將佢永遠擺喺櫃頂展示。等到我終於用咗，發現配方同粉盒本身一樣靚，我好放心。

Shimmer Souffle 令面頰有柔和嘅紅暈，帶少少發光效果，令皮膚睇落健康、清新。粉質滑，好易推開，唔會有斑駁感。係嗰種令你睇落自然靚，而唔係一眼睇到係化過妝嘅腮紅。

reviews.text: I really like their blushes. I usually go for matte ones but this one looks beautiful on the cheeks too! I love their quality and pigmentation. Definitely will buy more 😍
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意佢哋嘅腮紅。我通常揀霧面嗰啲，但係呢款喺面頰上都好靚！我好鍾意佢哋嘅質量同上色力。一定會再買多啲 😍

reviews.text: I got this in shade 05 - Bear Biscuit. It's a lovely brown-pink color, not super pigmented as tends to be with most AB brands but it looks very natural and you can build up the color of course. The packaging is adorable and high quality.
reviews.zh: 我買咗 05 - Bear Biscuit 呢個色。係好靚嘅啡粉紅色，唔似大部分 AB 品牌咁色素咁濃，但係睇落好自然，當然可以慢慢疊加顏色。包裝好可愛，質素都好好。

reviews.text: i purchased shade 03 and 04 and i lovveee 04 it’s the perfect bright pink for my skin tone but 03 is pretty orange on me as i am cool toned. but i love the shimmer in these blushes!
reviews.zh: 我買咗 03 同 04 色，我超級超級鍾意 04，啱我膚色嘅鮮粉紅色；但係 03 喺我身上好橙，因為我係冷色調。不過我好鍾意呢啲腮紅嘅閃粉！

reviews.text: This is my first flower knows product and it did not disappoint. Packaging is so cute it almost made me feel bad for using it and ruining the bear print but the formula makes up for it.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第一次用 Flower Knows 嘅產品，冇令我失望。包裝好可愛，可愛到我用嗰陣都有啲內疚，覺得弄花咗個熊仔圖案，但係配方彌補咗呢點。

reviews.text:
Not only the packaging is one of my favourite so far, it is also very easy to apply as blush is heavy pressed and gives pigment very gently, so you won’t end up looking as clown :)
I use it daily and love the shade too (I own pink one)
reviews.zh:
包裝唔單止係我而家最鍾意嘅之一，而且塗好易上手，因為腮紅壓得好實，色素釋放得好温和，所以唔會塗到好似小丑咁 :)
我每日都用，我都好鍾意個色（我有粉紅色嗰款）

reviews.text: I got this blusher in the shade 02 Garden Picnic. The packaging is absolutely gorgeous! And I love how pigmented C-beauty products are. The colour looks the same as the promotional photos. The colour looks more muted in the pan, but on the skin it looks like the same lively shade on the model. Love it!
reviews.zh: 我買咗 02 Garden Picnic 呢個色嘅腮紅。包裝超級靚！我好鍾意 C-beauty 產品嘅色素咁濃。色澤同宣傳相一樣。喺粉盒入面色澤比較柔和，但係塗喺皮膚上，就同模特兒身上嗰種生動嘅色調一樣。好鍾意！
